name: OmniFields – Custom Fields & Options Manager
author: Vivek Soni

sections.description:
OmniFields – Custom Fields & Options Manager is a modern, lightweight, and powerful custom fields solution for WordPress developers and site creators. Built from the ground up for speed, clean UX, and intuitive templating, it lets you add rich structured data to any post, page, custom post type, or global options page.

🌟 Key Features

  1. Advanced ACF-Style Location Rules:

    • Target entire Post Types or Specific Individual Pages (e.g., “Academics”, “Home”, “About Us”).
    • Target Specific Posts, Post Categories, or Post Statuses.
    • Target Page Templates (Default Template, custom theme templates).
    • Target Page Types (Front Page, Posts Page, Top Level Page, Parent Page, Child Page).
    • Target Current User Roles (Administrator, Editor, Author, etc.).
    • Target Options Pages & Sub-pages.
    • Powerful conditional logic: “and” (within same group) and “or” (between rule groups).

  2. Visual Field Group Builder:

    • Create custom field groups with live label sync, drag-and-drop sorting, and field duplication.
    • 18 rich field types supported.

  3. Options Pages & Sub-pages System:

    • Create top-level Options Pages in the WordPress sidebar (e.g. Theme Settings).
    • Create Sub-pages under any parent Options Page (e.g. Header, Footer, Social Media).
    • Custom Dashicon icons, menu slugs, and menu positions.

  4. 18 Supported Field Types:

    • Text, Textarea, Number, Email, URL, Password
    • Date, Time, Date & Time
    • Select (Dropdown), Radio buttons, Checkboxes
    • Image (with dropzone & live thumbnail preview)
    • Gallery (multi-image selector, thumbnail preview grid, remove icons, and drag-and-drop sortable)
    • File (with dropzone & file card preview)
    • Color picker
    • WYSIWYG Editor
    • Repeater (repeatable rows with sub-fields, drag-and-drop sorting)

  5. Intuitive PHP Template Functions:

    • Easy-to-use template functions: omni_get_field(), omni_the_field(), omni_get_option(), omni_get_image(), omni_get_gallery(), omni_get_repeater(), omni_have_rows(), omni_the_row(), omni_get_sub_field().
sections.installation:
1. Upload the omnifields folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP directly via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to OmniFields (or Custom Fields) in your WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Create your first Field Group or Options Page!
sections.faq:
How do I display a field value in my theme template?

Use omni_the_field('field_name') to print it directly, or $value = omni_get_field('field_name') to retrieve the value.

How do I get fields from an Options Page?

You can use omni_get_option('field_name') or pass 'option' as the second argument: omni_get_field('field_name', 'option').

How do Repeater fields work?

You can iterate through repeaters using simple array syntax with omni_get_repeater('my_repeater') or using the loop syntax:
if (omni_have_rows(‘my_repeater’)) { while (omni_have_rows(‘my_repeater’)) { omni_the_row(); echo esc_html(omni_get_sub_field(‘sub_title’)); } }

Is this plugin compatible with the block editor and classic editor?

Yes! OmniFields integrates seamlessly with both Gutenberg and Classic Editor.
